name: Azalea no Mahoutsukai ~step by step~
original_name: アゼリアの魔法使い ～step by step～
source:
The protagonist is Lou, a princess of a fallen kingdom.
Due to certain circumstances, she has lost the ability to walk properly.
Following the orders of Dias, the great sorcerer who took her in, she begins rehabilitation.
Will Lou be able to walk like a normal person again?
